prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a retro flip clock displaying the time "07:59 PM" dominates the center of the frame. The clock’s bold, segmented numerals are rendered in a cool, pale blue, standing out sharply against the dark, matte black casing. The background is softly out of focus, composed of a luminous grid of square lights that emit a diffused, bluish-white glow, creating a futuristic yet nostalgic ambiance. The lighting is moody and cinematic, with a gentle halo effect around the clock, emphasizing its silhouette and lending the scene a dreamlike quality. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and foreground, drawing all attention to the clock’s face and the anticipation of the impending time change. The overall color palette is cool and subdued, dominated by shades of blue, black, and white, evoking a sense of suspense and quiet anticipation. The style is reminiscent of neo-noir or retro-futuristic cinema, with a meticulous focus on atmosphere, light, and texture.
